title: Battle of Croix-des-Bouquets
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Croix-des-Bouquets", at revision 1370109349, opens: "The Battle of Croix-des-Bouquets took place during the Haitian Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890512, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1792 conflict in Haiti". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
